preferred: carpet area (RERA net usable floor area)
notes: Marketing materials must not quote prices or compare unit sizes solely based on 'super built-up area' or 'saleable area'. Advertisements must clearly disclose RERA carpet area in square feet (and optional square meters).

preferred: projected rental yield (market estimates, subject to risks)
notes: Phrases promising guaranteed returns or fixed monthly interest/yield are strictly banned under real estate marketing and regulatory guidelines.
Promoting residential projects as 'pre-launch' or 'soft launch' prior to receiving regulatory registration is illegal. Only officially registered projects under development may be marketed.

Possession timelines must be communicated as 'scheduled possession' or 'estimated handover' in accordance with developer registration filings. Do not use 'guaranteed possession' without noting force majeure conditions.

preferred: premium lifestyle amenities / contemporary community living
notes: Hospitality star ratings (e.g., '7-star') must not be applied to residential housing complexes unless an official hospitality brand tie-up has been formally certified.
